Container.Name: grid-postgres
Container.Overview: The database for Grid. Install this first, on the "grid" Docker network ("docker network create grid" once in the Unraid terminal). Keep its data on the cache pool (SSD).

Config.Name: Database data
Config.Description: Keep this on the cache pool (SSD), not the array: the database is written to all the time.

Config.Name: Password (POSTGRES_PASSWORD)
Config.Description: Make up a long password. Put the same one in Grid's "Database password".

Config.Name: Time zone (TZ)
Config.Description: Time zone for the database's logs. Unraid passes its own too; this overrides it.

Config.Name: Port (only if needed)
Config.Description: Leave blank: Grid reaches the database over the grid network. Set e.g. 5432 only to connect a database tool from another computer.
